RF-Scope APK build information
==============================

App name: RF-Scope
Package: com.rfscope.app
Version: 0.9.0 (versionCode 9)
Build type: debug (installable; Android Debug certificate)
Min SDK: 29 (Android 10)
Target/compile SDK: 34 (Android 14)
Built at: 2026-11-08 (Asia/Shanghai)
APK SHA-256: 5d3877f30b141ede090e1f0f49d07d7231b80cc816f007aeb0882c44c831cbfc
Size: 24929450 bytes

Changes in 0.9.0:
- Live spectrum performance: incremental bitmap waterfall renderer.
- Waterfall viewport is now 120 rows at 2dp per row, no per-scan full redraw.
- RBW and AVG settings are sent only when changed.
- TinySA-style tabbed menu: FREQ / LEVEL / MARKER / MEASURE / CONFIG.
- LIVE, SINGLE, TONE, TONE mode, and TONE REF are on the main screen.
- LEVEL tab supports auto/manual dBm scale and top/bottom range adjustment.
- Added RBW 600k and 850k options.
- Spectrum and waterfall stay frequency-locked with the same plot gutter.

Notes:
- Debug certificate; not suitable for Play Store publishing.
- Hardware behavior depends on TinySA firmware and OEM USB implementation.
